title: 집에서 쓰레기 배출·분리수거 핵심 어휘 10
summary: Ten must-know Korean words for sorting household waste and putting out trash in apartments/houses, with clear, natural example sentences and a short practice.
objective: Learners will understand and confidently use 10 key words related to household trash disposal and recycling, and be able to make short sentences for real-life use.

task.title: Sort your own trash
task.line: Pick 5 items that you throw away at home and say where each one goes in Korean, e.g., '이 캔은 헹군 다음 재활용으로 버려요.' Rules can differ by area, so check your building or local office notice.

exercises: Fill in the blanks: 생수를 다 마신 _____은 라벨을 떼고 찌그러뜨려 주세요. 택배 상자 안의 흰 _____은 테이프를 떼고 버리세요.
Fill in the blanks: 페트병에 붙은 비닐을 떼는 것을 _____라고 해요. 그다음 페트병은 _____으로 버리세요.
Fill in the blanks: 오늘은 우리 동네 재활용 _____이에요. 관리사무소 안내에 따라 캔은 헹군 다음 재활용 수거함에 _____하세요.
Fill in the blanks: 플라스틱, 종이, 캔을 섞지 말고 _____해서 버리세요. 먹다 남은 김치는 _____에 버려요.
Fill in the blanks: 다 쓴 칫솔 같은 _____는 _____에 넣어요.

words.exampleMeaning: Please throw dirty tissues into general waste.
I throw leftover rice into food waste.
Please put the trash in a designated paid bag.
Please put out the trash at the designated place.
Our apartment’s recycling collection day is Tuesday.
Remove the label from the bottle before throwing it away.
We collect clear PET bottles separately.
Empty the contents and put out the styrofoam for collection.
